title: feat: knowledge-graph view, recent-projects switcher, and editor-shell polish
body:
## Summary

This PR turns the Electron demo into a more complete, Obsidian-style editing shell and adds two navigation-oriented features on top of the existing engine, plus supporting core work. The headline feature is a **knowledge-graph view** that visualizes the vault's wiki-link network by reusing the existing `LinkIndex` — no new parsing layer.

It's structured as focused commits so each concern can be reviewed on its own.

## Highlights

- **Knowledge graph** (`feat(demo): knowledge-graph view…`) — `LinkIndex.getGraph()` exposes the forward-link graph as nodes + edges (unresolved links become "ghost" nodes). `graph-view.ts` renders it on a canvas with a cooled force simulation: drag-to-pin, wheel-zoom around the cursor, pan, hover-to-spotlight neighbours, click to open. Theme-aware via `--ds-*` tokens, caps at 500 nodes, idles cheaply when settled.
- **Recent-projects switcher** (`feat(demo): recent-projects quick switcher`) — a `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P` modal listing recent vaults. Missing folders are shown with a friendly hint and one-click removal (backed by non-pruning `vault:list-recents` / `vault:remove-recent` IPC).
- **Fenced code-block card** (`feat(core): fenced code-block card…`) — header toolbar (language, Wrap, Format, Copy, Edit) over highlighted output; `highlightCodeToHtml` + `formatCodeSource` and many more languages.
- **Editor shell** — frameless window chrome, editorial light/dark theme with a runtime color-scheme driver, image insert/paste/drop + fullscreen preview, a responsive toolbar overflow menu, and a resizable/collapsible file sidebar.
- **SCSS modularization** — the monolithic `style.css` is split into `styles/*.scss` partials (`@use`, `_variables`, `_mixins`), compiled by Vite. Verified byte-equivalent to the pre-split bundle.

## Fixes

- `fix(core): align table widget with code blocks…` — tables now line up with fenced code blocks and no longer render a phantom horizontal scrollbar when their content fits.
- Outline/backlinks now refresh on file open (silent `loadDocument` was skipping the `change` event).

## Testing

- `npm test` — **549 passing** (35 files), including new unit tests for `getGraph` (edges, ghosts, degree, self/anchor links) and the project switcher (render, switch, remove, empty state).
- `npm run typecheck` — clean across the workspace.
- Electron demo build — succeeds.

## Notes / trade-offs

- The graph and switcher live in the Electron demo (they consume the demo's `LinkIndex` and IPC bridge); the reusable part is `getGraph()` on the demo's link index.
- Tables render full-width; a table with 20+ narrow columns will spill past the card edge rather than scroll — a rare edge case accepted over showing a scrollbar on every table.
- Some UI strings are mixed EN/zh, matching the existing demo.

title: fix(wordcount): preserve table cell word boundaries
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Preserve lexical boundaries between adjacent GFM table cells so Markdown-aware word counts do not merge unrelated cell contents.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

`countMarkdown()` traversed table cells correctly but concatenated their text without a separator. A table containing `Alpha`, `Beta`, `Gamma`, and `Delta` was therefore analysed as `AlphaBetaGammaDelta` and reported one word. The same bug collapsed adjacent CJK cells into one run with `cjkUnit: "word"`.

- Issue: none; found during repository audit
- Roadmap: n/a
- OpenSpec change: n/a — bug fix with no public API change

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/plugin-wordcount`:
  - Preserve a lexical boundary after each `tableCell`.
  - Keep structural boundaries out of character statistics, so `characters` and `charactersNoSpaces` do not gain synthetic whitespace.
  - Count Latin tokens and collapsed CJK runs per lexical segment.
  - Add regression coverage for Latin and CJK GFM tables.

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` — 34 files, 539 tests passed
- [x] `pnpm typecheck`
- [x] `pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-plugin-wordcount build`
- [x] New regression tests: `packages/plugin-wordcount/test/count.test.ts`
- [x] Regression proof: before the fix both new cases reported `1`; after the fix they report `4`.
- [ ] Manual UI check: n/a — pure statistics helper, no UI changes

## Compliance / 合规自检

- [ ] **CLA signed** — pending first-time contributor check
- [ ] **AI disclosure**: functional implementation was developed with Codex assistance.
      AI-assisted notes: Codex assisted with repository audit, root-cause analysis, implementation, regression tests, validation, and PR drafting. This PR is intentionally draft so the contributor can review and defend every change before marking it ready.
- [x] **New dependencies**: none
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed
- [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits
- [x] Public API changes: none
- [x] `live-preview-table.ts`: not touched
- [x] New capability / breaking change: none; OpenSpec not required
- [x] Change aligns with project scope

## Review guide

The key invariant is that table cell boundaries affect word tokenisation only. Character counts continue to reflect extracted prose characters and do not include synthetic separators.

title: feat(core): add list item drag reorder
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Adds accessible list-item reorder handles to core live preview, supporting mouse drag and keyboard movement while preserving Markdown structure, numbering style, task state, and atomic undo.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

- Issue: n/a
- Roadmap (`docs/ROADMAP.md`): n/a — the capability is tracked by the existing OpenSpec change rather than the current roadmap
- OpenSpec change: `add-missing-features`, task 2.4 — List item drag reorder

Reordering a Markdown list currently requires selecting and moving raw source manually, which is error-prone for loose lists, task items, ordered markers, and parents with nested children. Grip-based reordering makes this a direct editing primitive while keeping Markdown text as the source of truth.

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/core`:
  - **New pure module `src/list-reorder.ts`** — builds one atomic CodeMirror replacement from mdast-derived sibling ranges. Item bodies move as units, list separators remain attached to destination slots, and ordered lists reuse destination markers so sequential, custom-start, and all-ones numbering styles are preserved.
  - **New `src/live-preview-list.ts`** — extracts list rendering from `live-preview.ts` and adds same-level grip handles, mouse drag targeting, visual drop indicators, ArrowUp/ArrowDown movement, Escape cancellation, focus restoration, and listener/style cleanup on blur or widget destruction.
  - **New `src/live-preview-widget.ts`** — extracts the shared lazy/stable widget factory from the live-preview core, reducing the size and responsibility of `live-preview.ts`.
  - **Locale/types wiring** — adds English/Chinese `reorderListItem` labels while keeping the new locale field optional for backward compatibility; resolved locales still provide a required label.
  - Reordering keeps task checkbox state, loose-list spacing, indentation, and complete nested subtrees. Each move is dispatched as one transaction and therefore one undo step.
- `openspec/`:

title: feat(search): add fuzzy search mode with subsequence matcher
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Adds an opt-in `fuzzy` toggle to the search panel (`plugin-search`) that navigates documents with a fzf-style subsequence matcher instead of literal/regular-expression matching.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

- Issue: n/a
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): #17 — Fuzzy search (`plugin-search`, P2, `Needs OpenSpec: No`)
- OpenSpec change: none required (feature is additive, scoped to `plugin-search`, no new capability/breaking API)

Long docs are hard to grep when you don't remember the exact spelling. A fuzzy (subsequence) matcher lets users type an approximate query (`hwd` → `hello world`) and jump straight to the result, matching the UX of tools like fzf and VS Code's `#` quick search.

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/plugin-search`:
  - **New pure module `src/fuzzy.ts`** — `fuzzyMatch(query, text, caseSensitive)` returns a score + matched positions for a subsequence match; `findFuzzyMatches(doc, query, options)` scans the document line-by-line so a match span never crosses a newline. Scoring rewards consecutive runs and word-boundary/start-of-string hits, and applies a length penalty so tighter matches win. Note: this is a **greedy** matcher (first-fit per query char); a backtracking matcher is deferred as future work (documented in the roadmap row).
  - **`src/index.ts`** — new `fuzzy` option on `SearchOptions`/`SearchPluginOptions`/`SearchPluginLabels` (default off, so existing behavior is unchanged); `nexusSearchStateField` StateField tracks query/fuzzy/caseSensitive; a ViewPlugin renders fuzzy matches with highlight decorations; `fuzzyFindNext` / `fuzzyFindPrevious` / `fuzzySelectAll` / `fuzzyReplaceNext` / `fuzzyReplaceAll` commands; panel gains a `Fuzzy` checkbox and branches navigation/replace between literal and fuzzy paths; `createSearchPlugin` wires the keymap (`Mod-g` / `Mod-Shift-g`) and highlight plugin.
  - **`package.json`** — adds `@codemirror/state` direct dependency (was previously only transitive).
- `docs/ROADMAP.md` — #17 status `planned` → `in-progress`, notes updated to describe the greedy-subsequence approach.

## Testing / 测试

title: fix(core): honor remark syntax extensions in public AST
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Make the editor's public AST use the configured remark parse pipeline when remark plugins are present, so syntax extensions such as `remark-math` are reflected consistently in `getAst()`, change events, outline generation, and AST-based plugins.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

Remark syntax extensions must participate while Markdown is parsed. The previous path converted CodeMirror's Lezer tree to mdast first and only then ran remark transformers, so extensions could not create nodes such as `inlineMath`. Widgets could render the extended syntax through a separate parser while public AST consumers still received plain text.

- Issue: none
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): none
- OpenSpec change: not required (bug fix; no public API change)

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/core`:
  - route public AST parsing through the existing full remark pipeline when remark plugins are configured
  - retain custom-parser precedence and the plugin-free incremental Lezer fast path
  - share a one-entry parse cache between public AST and widget consumers
  - isolate cached trees from transformer, public API, and widget mutations
  - cancel stale delayed change work before silent document loads
- `packages/plugin-math`:
  - cover `getAst()`, change callbacks, and semantic outline text for inline math
- `packages/plugin-wordcount`:
  - verify editor-mode counting matches standalone counting and excludes math nodes
- `apps/electron-demo`: none
- `openspec/`: none

- [x] `pnpm typecheck` passes / 类型检查通过

  - outline uses semantic math node values

  - cached AST is isolated from plugin, widget, and public mutations, including cycles and common built-ins
  - silent document and range replacements cancel stale delayed changes
- [x] Manual UI check in electron-demo / electron-demo 手动验证：

title: fix(electron): preserve edits across debounced saves
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Prevent the Electron demo from losing or misclassifying edits when Save, Save As, or file switching happens inside the editor's 150 ms debounced `onChange` window.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

The demo deliberately debounces the AST/change pipeline with `parseDelayMs: 150`, but it also treated the debounced `state.content` and `state.dirty` fields as the persistence source of truth. This creates three races:

1. Save immediately after typing can write the previous buffer to disk.
2. Switch files immediately after typing can skip the discard prompt.
3. Typing while file I/O is in flight can be incorrectly marked clean when the older snapshot finishes saving.

A pending callback from the previous document can also arrive after a silent file load and overwrite the new file's renderer state and link-index input.

- Issue: none; found during repository audit
- Roadmap: n/a
- OpenSpec change: n/a — bug fix with no public API change

## Changes / 变更内容

- `apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/state.ts`
  - Track the exact `savedContent` baseline separately from the latest observed editor buffer.
  - Derive `dirty` from the buffer/baseline comparison.
  - Reconcile a completed save against the current live buffer so edits made during I/O remain dirty.
- `apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/app.ts`
  - Read Save and Save As snapshots directly from `editor.getDocument()`.
  - Check the live document before allowing a file switch.
- `apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/editor-shell.ts`
  - Ignore debounced change payloads superseded by a silent load or newer edit.
- Tests
  - Cover pre-debounce unsaved detection, persisted-baseline transitions, typing during save, and the old-document callback race.

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm typecheck`
- [x] `pnpm test` — 34 files, 541 tests passed
- [x] `pnpm build`
- [x] `pnpm build:electron-demo`
- [x] Regression proof: removing the stale-callback guard makes the new file-load race test fail with the previous file's content.
- [ ] Manual UI check in electron-demo

## Compliance / 合规自检

- [ ] **CLA signed** — pending first-time contributor check
- [x] **AI assistance disclosed** — Codex assisted with repository audit, root-cause analysis, implementation, regression tests, and validation. The PR is intentionally draft so the contributor can review and defend every state transition before marking it ready.
- [x] **New dependencies** — none
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed
- [x] **No secrets / `.env` / personal vault data committed**
- [x] Bug fix is within `apps/electron-demo` scope and introduces no public API or OpenSpec change.

## Review guide

The key invariant is:

```
dirty === (editor.getDocument() !== savedContent)
```

A save records only the snapshot actually written. If the live editor has advanced before I/O completes, the newer buffer stays dirty.

title: fix(electron): support Unicode unlinked mentions
body:
## Summary / 摘要

我是邵梦月，在 Boss 上得到这份作业，提交至此。

Fix Electron demo unlinked-mention detection for CJK and other Unicode note names while preserving whole-word behavior for alphabetic scripts.

修复 Electron demo 中中文、日文、韩文及其他 Unicode 笔记名称无法被识别为未链接提及的问题，同时保留字母文字的整词匹配语义。

## Motivation / 背景与动机

`LinkIndex.getUnlinkedMentions()` previously wrapped an escaped note name with JavaScript `\b` boundaries. JavaScript defines `\b` around ASCII-style word characters, so note names such as `项目计划` produced no matches at all. Accented names also had inconsistent boundaries, for example `Café` could not be handled with true Unicode word semantics.

This made the backlinks panel incomplete for multilingual vaults even though the underlying text contained exact note-name mentions.

- Issue: N/A (identified through code review and a failing regression test)
- Roadmap: N/A (bug fix)
- OpenSpec: N/A (restores existing behavior; no public API or new capability)

## Changes / 变更内容

- `apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/link-index.ts`
  - Replace ASCII-only `\b` matching with case-insensitive Unicode matching.
  - Add code-point-safe boundary checks for alphabetic and numeric scripts.
  - Use exact substring semantics when a note name starts or ends with a CJK character, because CJK prose commonly has no whitespace word separators.
  - Keep regex escaping, wiki-link exclusion, snippets, offsets, and caching behavior unchanged.
- `apps/electron-demo/test/link-index.test.ts`
  - Add a CJK regression covering two unseparated `项目计划` mentions.
  - Add an accented-Latin regression proving `Café` matches independently but not inside `caféine`.

## Testing / 测试

The CJK regression was verified to fail before the implementation (`0` matches instead of `2`).

- [x] `node_modules/.bin/vitest run` — 34 test files, 539 tests passed

title: fix(core): restore AST fidelity for headings, titles and reference links
body:
## Summary / 摘要 Fix three fidelity defects in the Lezer→mdast adapter that silently dropped heading text, link/image titles, and reference-link destinations from `editor.getAst()`. 修复 Lezer→mdast adapter 的三处保真度缺陷：标题文字、link/image 的 title、 以及引用式链接的目标地址在 `editor.getAst()` 中被静默丢弃。 ## Motivation / 背景与动机 `lezerStringToMdast` is the single chokepoint every AST consumer reads through — the outline, word count, `exportHTML()`, and any plugin calling `getAst()`. Three things it produced did not match what `remark-parse` produces for the same source, so the loss was invisible in the editor and surfaced only downstream. **1. Setext and closed ATX headings lost all their text.** `headingTextRange` was written for one heading shape: skip the leading `HeaderMark` run, then trim a trailing one. Both CommonMark heading forms use the same `HeaderMark` node name, so that walk misreads the other two layouts: | source | Lezer children | old result | |---|---|---| | `# Title` | `HeaderMark` | correct | | `Title\n=====` | `HeaderMark` (the underline, **after** the text) | `children: []` | | `## Title ##` | `HeaderMark`, `HeaderMark` (adjacent siblings) | `children: []` | For setext the sole mark is the underline, so it was skipped as the opening mark *and* trimmed as the closing mark, leaving `cursor` past `end`. For closed ATX, Lezer keeps the heading text in raw source rather than a child node, so the two marks are immediate siblings and the leading `while` consumed both. Either way `depth` and `position` stayed correct while `children` came out empty. That is why it went unnoticed: the editor's live-preview decoration reads the syntax tree directly and looked fine, while AST consumers broke — - outline entries rendered as clickable buttons with **no accessible name** (WCAG 4.1.2), since `outline-panel.ts` sets `textContent` from `entry.text` - `plugin-wordcount` under-counted (a 15-word document reported 5) - `exportHTML()` emitted `

` `lezer-helpers.ts` already maps `SetextHeading1`/`SetextHeading2` to a depth, so setext was meant to work — this is a regression in the text path, not a missing feature. **2. `title` was hardcoded to `null`** on every Link and Image, though Lezer exposes it as a `LinkTitle` child. `live-preview-table.ts` already reads `node.title`, so it was reading a value that could never be set. **3. Reference links were emitted as plain links with the raw source as the url.** `[full][ref]` became `{type: "link", url: "[full][ref]"}`, which exports as `` — a dead link. In the editor it also fell through to the GFM bare-URL branch, hiding no brackets and publishing the same string as `data-link-url`. mdast models these as `linkReference`/`imageReference` with the destination left in the companion `definition`; `plugin-wordcount` already handles both node types, which suggests that was always the intended output. - Issue: — - Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): — - OpenSpec change: — (bug fixes only; no new capability, per CONTRIBUTING.md §3.1) ## Changes / 变更内容 - `packages/core`: - `lezer-mdast-adapter.ts` - `headingTextRange`: split the setext and ATX shapes apart instead of sharing one walk, and take a single node at each end rather than looping. - `readLinkTitle`: read the `LinkTitle` child, stripping whichever of the three CommonMark delimiter pairs it carries (`"…"`, `'…'`, `(…)`) and collapsing an empty title to `null` to match remark. - `unwrapUrl`: drop the `<…>` delimiters around a destination — the form exists so a url may contain spaces, and the brackets are not part of it. - `readReference`: classify the three reference forms off the `LinkLabel` child and emit `linkReference` / `imageReference`. - `readLinkLabelChildren`: the existing label walk, extracted from an inline IIFE so references reuse it and keep nested marks (`[**bold**][ref]` stays a `strong`). - `adaptLinkReference`: read the `LinkLabel` / `URL` / `LinkTitle` children instead of re-parsing the line with `/^\[([^\]]+)\]:\s*(\S+)(?:\s+"([^"]*)")?/`, which lost three things the node tree already had right — `\S+` truncated an angle-bracketed url at the first space, only the double-quoted title form matched, and `identifier` kept the author's casing where mdast case-folds it so `[Foo]` resolves against `[foo]: …`. - `types.ts`, `live-preview-ranges.ts`, `live-preview.ts`: changing the node type means the decoration path has to follow, or the editor silently stops rendering reference links. `linkReference` joins the `LivePreviewNode` union and the `isLivePreviewNode` allowlist, and `getInlineMarkerStyle` gains a case that hides the brackets without attaching a url it does not have. - `packages/plugin-*`: — - `apps/electron-demo`: — - `openspec/`: — ### Known deviation from remark Documented on `readReference`: CommonMark only treats `[text][ref]` as a reference when a matching definition exists, and falls back to literal text otherwise. Checking that needs every definition in the document up front, which would turn this adapter's single pass into two — and staying cheap enough for the live-preview hot path is the reason it exists (see the note at the top of the file). So an undefined reference is still emitted as a `linkReference`; consumers that care can check `identifier` against the document's `definition` nodes. Happy to revisit if you'd rather take the second pass. ## Testing / 测试 - [x] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿 — **569 passed / 36 files** (baseline on `main`: 537 / 34). The three commits were verified one at a time, not just the tip: 546 → 558 → 569, no regressions at any step. - [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) / 受影响包构建通过 — `pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-core build` (ESM + DTS), and `tsc --noEmit` clean. - [x] New / updated vitest cases / 新增或更新的 vitest 用例： - `test/lezer-mdast-adapter.test.ts` (new, 9) — setext h1/h2 text, inline marks inside a setext heading, setext vs equivalent ATX agreeing, ATX marker stripping, closed ATX (`## Closed ##`, `## Trail #`, `###### Six ######`), `position` spanning the underline, empty setext not throwing. - `test/lezer-mdast-adapter-links.test.ts` (new, 12+11) — the three title delimiter forms, empty title → `null`, whitespace inside a title preserved, title kept out of the label, `<…>` url unwrapping, the three reference forms with case-folded `identifier` and verbatim `label`, nested marks in a reference label, `imageReference` alt text, inline links still plain links, and definition parsing. - `test/live-preview-ranges.test.ts`, `test/live-preview.test.ts` (updated) — reference links stay in the range set under the new node type, their brackets are hidden, and no `data-link-url` is published. - [x] Manual UI check in electron-demo / electron-demo 手动验证： A document with one setext h1, one setext h2, one ATX h1 and one closed ATX h2, opened side by side against `main` (screenshots below). The outline went from a single labelled entry — the other three headings rendered as buttons with no accessible name — to all four labelled and correctly indented, and the word count from `6 words / 15 chars` to `20 words / 46 chars`. Not covered, and deliberately out of scope: in the editor body, setext headings are still not styled as headings, and a closed ATX heading — now correctly recognised as one — still shows its trailing `##`. Both live in the `live-preview.ts` decoration path, a separate concern from AST fidelity, and worth a follow-up PR rather than widening this diff. ## Compliance / 合规自检 - [ ] **CLA signed** — first-time contributors will be prompted automatically by the CLA bot / 首次贡献者按 CLA 机器人提示签署 - [ ] **AI disclosure**: the functional code in this PR is **not** primarily generated by AI. AI assistance, if any, is described below. AI-assisted notes / AI 使用说明: Claude Code was used throughout, including for the functional code. It analysed the adapter and its consumers, proposed candidate defects, and each one was reproduced in a running editor to confirm the behaviour and locate the cause before any code was written. Scope, commit boundaries and the side-by-side verification against an unmodified `main` were my calls; the diagnosis for the closed-ATX case took two attempts, the first being wrong until the Lezer tree was dumped. - [x] **New dependencies** (if any) listed with license & rationale (none if blank): none / 无 - [x] **No build artifacts** committed (`dist/`, `dist-electron/`, compiled `.js` from `.ts`) / 未提交构建产物 - [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed / 无敏感信息 ## Checklist / 自检清单 - [x] Title follows Conventional Commits / 标题遵循 Conventional Commits - [x] Public API changes update package README / types — 改了公共 API 已同步 README 与类型 — `LivePreviewNode` in `types.ts` gains `LinkReference`. `getAst()` now returns `linkReference` / `imageReference` where it previously returned `link` / `image` for reference syntax; that is the mdast-correct shape, but it is a visible change for anyone switching on `node.type`, so flagging it explicitly. Happy to add a note to the core README if you'd like. - [x] Touched `live-preview-table.ts` → walked through the 12 Table Widget rules in CLAUDE.md / 已核对 12 条表格规则 — not touched (n/a) - [x] New capability / breaking change → OpenSpec proposal linked / 新 capability 或破坏性变更已附 OpenSpec — no new capability; see the API note above - [x] Change aligns with project scope (GOVERNANCE.md §4) / 改动符合 GOVERNANCE.md §4 的项目范围 ## Screenshots / Recordings · 截图或录屏 (UI changes) Same document, same demo, `main` on the left and this branch on the right. **Before** — the outline lists one heading; the two setext headings and the closed ATX heading are missing their labels entirely. **After** — all four headings labelled and indented by depth; word count corrected from 6 to 20.

title: feat(paste): add HTML-to-Markdown paste conversion plugin
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Add `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-paste` — converts rich-text clipboard HTML to clean Markdown on paste.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

- **Issue:** (none — filling an existing gap)
- **Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md):** #30 (new)
- **OpenSpec change:** `openspec/changes/add-plugin-paste`

`@floatboat/nexus-core` already reserves a `handlers.paste` hook (`EditorEventHandlers` in `core/src/types.ts`) and exposes `EditorEventContext.insertMarkdown`, but **no plugin consumes them**. The paste handler in `core/src/editor.ts` dispatches to plugin hooks first, then falls back to its own asset-upload logic. Pasting formatted text from a browser / Office / Google Docs currently dumps raw HTML into the document. This plugin fills that reserved extension point — opt-in, no core changes.

## Changes / 变更内容

- **`packages/core`:** none — no core changes.
- **`packages/plugin-*`:** new `packages/plugin-paste`:
  - `src/convert.ts` — pure function `convertHtmlToMarkdown(html, options)` using `turndown` + `turndown-plugin-gfm` (tables, task lists, strikethrough). Never throws; falls back to tag-stripped text.
  - `src/plugin.ts` — `createPastePlugin()` registers `handlers.paste`: files pass through to core's `onAssetUpload`; no `text/html` passes through to CodeMirror; otherwise convert + `ctx.insertMarkdown`.
  - 28 tests (19 pure-function + 7 plugin integration + 2 real-DOM e2e dispatching a real `ClipboardEvent` through core's `domEventHandlers`).
- **`apps/electron-demo`:** none.
- **`openspec/`:** new `changes/add-plugin-paste` (proposal / design / tasks / spec).

title: Fix slash command confirmation creating two undo entries
body:
## Summary

Previously, confirming a slash command (`/bold` + Enter) generated one
undo entry for removing the trigger text and another for applying the
selected command, requiring two Undo operations to fully revert a
single user action.

Slash confirmation now behaves as one logical editing operation and
can be reverted with a single Undo.

## Root cause

Slash confirmation performs two sequential editor mutations:

- remove the `/query` trigger
- execute the selected command

These operations were previously committed as separate editor
transactions, producing two undo history entries.

CodeMirror's `dispatch(...specs)` cannot preserve this editing flow,
because every `TransactionSpec` is interpreted relative to the same
original document, while slash confirmation requires sequential edits.

## Fix

Introduce a small `editor.transact()` helper that groups multiple
editor mutations into one undoable operation.

The helper is currently used only by slash command confirmation.

## Scope

This change only affects slash command confirmation.
Toolbar, search, table editing, and other editor behaviors remain
unchanged.

## Verification

- `pnpm test` → pass (545 tests)
- `pnpm typecheck` → pass
- `pnpm build` → pass
- `git diff --check` → pass

Regression coverage added for:

- atomic undo of multi-step editor operations
- nested transaction rejection
- callback exception rollback
- slash command confirmation
- existing toolbar undo behavior
- All existing tests continue to pass.

## Compliance

  ChatGPT and OpenCode were used to assist with code exploration,
  implementation discussion, and regression test drafting.
  The final code and this pull request were reviewed before submission.

- No new dependencies or build artifacts.

title: fix(react,vue): restore rejected controlled edits
body:
## Summary

Restore the parent-owned document after React or Vue controlled bindings reject an editor-originated change.

## Motivation

The controlled bindings only reconciled when `value` / `modelValue` changed. After an editor change, both bindings recorded the edited document as the last synchronized value. If the parent deliberately kept its existing value—for example, validation rejected the edit—the prop remained unchanged, no synchronization ran, and the editor incorrectly continued displaying the rejected content.

## Changes

- React: retain the internal synchronization revision and include it in the controlled-document reconciliation effect.
- Vue: watch both `modelValue` and the internal synchronization revision.
- In both bindings, accepted edits remain untouched while rejected edits are restored silently from the parent-owned value.
- Add integration tests for rejected edits in React and Vue, strengthen React accepted-edit coverage, and add equivalent Vue accepted-edit coverage.

## Testing

- [x] Regression tests observed failing in both React and Vue before the implementation
- [x] `pnpm vitest run packages/react/test/editor-react.test.tsx packages/vue/test/editor-vue.test.ts` — 28 tests passed

## OpenSpec

title: fix(electron): preserve UNC roots in path joins
body:
## Summary

Preserve the leading `//` authority marker when `joinPath` receives a UNC path, restoring relative WikiLink resolution for Electron vaults hosted on Windows network shares.

## Motivation

`normalizeSlashes` deliberately retains UNC paths as `//server/share/...`, but `joinPath` collapsed every slash run to one slash. `LinkIndex.resolve` uses `joinPath` to build relative candidates, so a source under `\\server\share\vault` produced `/server/share/vault/...` and could not match the normalized file path. When duplicate basenames prevented the fallback resolver from choosing a unique note, a valid relative WikiLink resolved to `null`.

## Changes

- Detect the UNC prefix before collapsing redundant path separators and restore the second leading slash afterward.
- Add a direct `joinPath` regression test.
- Add a `LinkIndex.resolve` integration test with ambiguous basenames, proving that relative UNC resolution succeeds without relying on the basename fallback.

## Testing

- [x] `pnpm test` — 34 files, 539 tests passed
- [x] `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p apps/electron-demo/tsconfig.json`
- [x] `pnpm build:electron-demo`
- [x] `git diff --check`

The repository-level `pnpm typecheck` command currently invokes `tsc` in the workspace root, which has no `tsconfig.json`; it exits after printing TypeScript help. The affected Electron application passes its scoped typecheck above.

## OpenSpec

No OpenSpec change: this is a focused bug fix that restores the path identity already preserved by `normalizeSlashes`.

## AI assistance disclosure

AI assistance was used to diagnose the UNC path bug, draft the small implementation, and generate the regression tests. The bug was reproduced with failing tests before the fix, and all listed checks were run after the fix. No dependencies were added.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

Nexus currently provides React and Vue bindings, but vanilla/custom-element consumers and applications that isolate the editor in an iframe must manage the core lifecycle and cross-window protocol themselves. - `packages/core`:
  - Cancel obsolete delayed change notifications when a newer silent document replacement supersedes them, preventing controlled hosts from rolling back to stale content. Both silent entry points (`setDocument` and `replaceRange`) share the same cancellation helper so the two paths cannot drift.
- `packages/wc`:
  - Add the light-DOM `<nexus-editor>` element, controlled/uncontrolled values, lifecycle-safe reparenting, composed `nexus-*` events, and DOM typings.

title: feat(wordcount): support aggregated statistics for multi-cursor multiple selections
body:
## Feature Overview
Enhance the built-in wordcount plugin to calculate total selected text when using multiple cursors.

### Problem
Original logic only reads the primary selection via `editor.getSelection()`. When users select several discontinuous text blocks with multi-cursor, the "Selected" count on the status bar only counts the first range, causing inaccurate statistics and misleading operation feedback.

### Implementation
1. Replace single `getSelection()` with `getSelections()` to obtain all cursor ranges
2. Filter empty cursor positions without actual selection
3. Deduplicate overlapping selected ranges to avoid repeated accumulation
4. Reuse existing internal `countMarkdown` method to sum characters / words / lines
5. Fully backward compatible: single cursor mode remains completely unchanged, no breaking changes

### Quality & Compatibility
- Added regression unit test for multi-cursor multi-selection scenario
- Local full test passed: single selection, multi non-overlap selection, overlap selection, empty cursor all work correctly
- ESLint lint rules and all existing test cases passed locally

### Self-test Result
1. Single cursor single selection → consistent with original statistics
2. Multi-cursor non-overlapping text → sum all selected content normally
3. Overlapping selected area → deduplicate counting
4. Blank cursor without selection → Selected shows 0

<!--
feat(search): Unicode-safe fuzzy matching with preview UI
-->
## Summary / 摘要

Implements fzf-style fuzzy subsequence matching for the search plugin — code-point aware, zero-dependency, fully tested — and surfaces it in the electron-demo search bar with a live match preview.

为 search 插件实现 fzf 风格的模糊子序列匹配：码点感知（emoji/CJK 安全）、零依赖、测试完备，并在 electron-demo 搜索栏中提供可视化匹配预览。

## Motivation / 背景与动机

Literal search forces users to remember exact wording; fuzzy subsequence matching lets them type `fzs` and find `fuzzy search` — the lookup style users expect from VS Code / fzf / Obsidian Quick Switcher. This matters for a Markdown-native editor whose users live in large note vaults.

精确匹配要求用户记住原文措辞；模糊子序列匹配允许输入 `fzs` 命中 `fuzzy search`，这是用户在 VS Code / fzf / Obsidian 中习惯的查找方式。对面向大型笔记库的 Markdown 编辑器而言，这是查找体验的基础能力。

- Issue: —
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): **#17 Fuzzy search** (`plugin-search`, P2)
- OpenSpec change: — (additive plugin API + demo integration; no breaking change, per CONTRIBUTING §3.1)

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/plugin-search`:
  - New `fuzzy.ts`: greedy subsequence matcher with position scoring (word-boundary bonus +10, consecutive-run bonus +15*run, gap penalty -3/char). Exported as pure functions `fuzzyMatch` / `findFuzzyMatches` alongside `FuzzyMatch` / `FuzzySearchOptions` types.
  - `SearchOptions.fuzzy` / `fuzzyMaxGap` wire fuzzy mode into the existing `findSearchMatches` / `replaceAllMatches` — mutually exclusive with `regexp` / `wholeWord`.
  - **Code-point aware matching**: comparison and cursor advancement operate on whole code points, so an emoji in the query actually matches (previously impossible because `text[i]` splits surrogate pairs), positions never land inside a surrogate pair, and `maxGap` / gap penalties are measured in code points rather than code units. Returned offsets stay in UTF-16 code units, matching editor selection coordinates (CodeMirror, Monaco, textarea), so callers can feed `from`/`to`/`positions` straight into selection and highlight APIs.
  - Emoji count as word boundaries (`\p{S}`), so `👋hello` scores `hello` at a boundary.
- `apps/electron-demo`:
  - Search bar gains an **Fz toggle** (or `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F`) switching to fuzzy subsequence matching; replace-all honours the active mode.
  - **Match preview row** renders the current match window with every matched character `<mark>`-ed, plus the match score and offsets — subsequence matching becomes visible instead of magic.
  - Search input is **debounced (80 ms)** so re-searching never blocks a keystroke.
- `packages/core`: — (no changes)
- `openspec/`: — (not required; see above)

## Performance / 性能

Measured on this branch (Node 22, Windows x64), scanning a **169,000-character** document:

| Operation | Time | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `findFuzzyMatches("fzs")` | **14.0 ms** | 2,999 matches |
| `findFuzzyMatches("qux")` | 9.7 ms | 3,000 matches |
| `findFuzzyMatches("👋")` | 13.1 ms | 1,000 matches |
| `fuzzyMatch("fzs")` (best-match scan) | 12.2 ms | — |

A full-document fuzzy scan fits inside one 60 fps frame budget (16.7 ms); combined with the 80 ms input debounce in the demo, typing stays at full frame rate even on ~170k-char documents. Zero runtime dependencies added — bundle delta is the matcher itself (~3 KB min).

全文模糊扫描单帧预算（16.7ms）内完成；配合 demo 中 80ms 输入防抖，约 17 万字符文档上输入保持满帧。零新增运行时依赖，包体积增量仅匹配器本身（约 3 KB min）。

title: fix(live-preview): anchor column grips to header cells
body:
## Summary

Move live-preview table column-selection and column-reorder grips from a synthetic standalone `<tr>` into their owning header `<th>` cells, so each grip tracks the column it controls through selection, resize, and reorder.

## Problem

- The standalone grip row was not the semantic owner of any content column. Width measurement, hover handling, and row targeting therefore relied on synthetic row indexes and could misalign grips from their columns.
- Column deletion must continue to work when CodeMirror owns focus. The document-level keydown handler is guarded for active table selection and editable-cell focus, and is removed when the widget is destroyed.

## Changes

- Render each `.nexus-col-grip` inside its corresponding header `<th>` as an absolute overlay.
- Remove the standalone column-grip row.
- Replace synthetic-row index lookups with semantic header/body row helpers.
- Add a 5px maybe-drag threshold: a Grip click establishes selection, while movement beyond the threshold starts custom column reorder.
- Preserve document-level Delete/Backspace handling for Grip-established column and row selection.
- Remove the document keydown listener when the table widget is destroyed.
- Preserve row Grip drag/reorder, range selection, cell editing, outside deselection, and the existing column-resize hit area.
- Column-resize behavior, Markdown serialization, public APIs, and runtime dependencies remain unchanged.

## Verification

pnpm test → pass (542 tests)
pnpm typecheck → pass
pnpm build → pass
pnpm build:electron-demo → pass
pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/test/editor.test.ts packages/core/test/live-preview.test.ts packages/plugin-search/test/plugin-search.test.ts → pass (164 tests)
git diff --check → pass

New or extended regression coverage in `packages/core/test/live-preview.test.ts` includes header-owned Grip DOM, Grip selection and column deletion, document-level Delete when the table wrapper does not own focus, keydown-listener cleanup on widget destruction, outside deselection, and DOM preservation during cell editing.

Electron demo verification covered header-owned Grip alignment, Grip-established column deletion, column reorder, row Grip reorder, outside deselection, and resize alignment.

The table-widget interaction rules were reviewed, with regression coverage and Electron verification included.

## Compliance

**AI assistance disclosure:** Codex assisted with reproducing edge cases and drafting the follow-up fixes and regression tests. Human maintainer review is requested and required before merge.

No new dependencies, build artifacts, secrets, or personal document data are included.

title: feat(search): add fzf-style fuzzy subsequence matching
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Add a zero-dependency, fzf-style fuzzy (subsequence) matcher to `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-search`, exposed both as a standalone `fuzzyMatch()` utility and via a non-breaking `fuzzy` option on existing search utilities. Lands roadmap item #17.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

- Issue: N/A
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): #17 Fuzzy search (`plugin-search`, P2, status: `done`). Requirement: *"Evaluate fzf-like algorithm vs. third-party lib; needs backtracking matcher."*
- OpenSpec change: N/A (roadmap marks #17 as "No OpenSpec"; non-breaking additive option).

The search plugin already ships literal, whole-word, and regex matching. Fuzzy/subsequence matching is a key feature for editor-level searching. The roadmap explicitly calls for a **backtracking matcher** rather than a greedy left-to-right scan to avoid low-scoring alignments.

## Problem

The repository has a well-established Vitest/jsdom suite, but the Electron Demo has no end-to-end automation boundary. Renderer-level tests cannot validate Electron main/renderer integration, native-dialog handling, real file persistence, or complete user workflows.

## Solution

This PR introduces a reusable Playwright Electron E2E harness for the Electron Demo.

- Reusable Electron fixture that launches the built `dist-electron/main.js` entry point.
- Isolated temporary workspace and Electron `user-data-dir` for every test.
- Renderer diagnostics for `console.error` and `pageerror`, plus Electron stderr capture.
- Failure artifacts: Playwright trace, screenshot, HTML report, and attached Electron diagnostics.
- A dedicated GitHub Actions E2E job running under `xvfb-run` on Ubuntu 24.04.
- A test-only `NEXUS_E2E=1` guard around the main-process native dialog stub.

## Covered workflows

- Application launch and accessible Markdown editor readiness.
- Markdown editing with undo and redo assertions.
- File lifecycle: open, edit, save, verify persisted contents with Node `fs.readFile`, modify on disk, and reopen through the application.

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build

body:
# feat(search): add fuzzy matching to the editor search panel

## What I worked on

I implemented roadmap item #17 by adding fuzzy search to the editor's existing search panel. My goal was to make the search more forgiving when I only remember some characters of a word, while keeping the current search workflow and UI familiar.

I kept this as a small MVP. The search state stays inside `plugin-search`, I did not change `packages/core`, and I did not add a dependency or a new global state store.

- Roadmap: `docs/ROADMAP.md` #17 Fuzzy search
- Issue: N/A

## What changed

### Fuzzy search

- Added a Fuzzy toggle to the existing search panel.
- Matches query characters in order inside one alphanumeric/underscore token.
- Highlights the individual matched characters.
- Keeps results in document order for previous/next navigation.
- Shows an inline empty state when there are no fuzzy matches.
- Caps retained fuzzy results at 1,000 so a large document cannot create an unbounded number of decorations.

### Live Preview links

Search highlights could be hidden by the rendered Markdown link layer. I added temporary, plugin-scoped markers for visible link text so a match remains visible without changing the core link renderer or link navigation.

### UI fixes found while testing

- Moved tooltips to fixed overlays so hovering toolbar buttons no longer changes layout or makes a scrollbar flash.
- Kept the search controls, focus feedback, and tooltip labels consistent with the existing toolbar style.
- Aligned the header baselines of Vault, the editor toolbar, Outline, and Backlinks in the Electron demo.

## Scope and compatibility

- `packages/core`: unchanged.
- No new packages or dependencies.
- Fuzzy state, navigation state, and temporary link-marker cleanup remain in `plugin-search`.
- Existing complete `SearchPluginLabels` objects remain source-compatible.
- Fuzzy matching does not cross whitespace or punctuation.

## Testing

I ran the following checks:

- `pnpm test` — 34 test files, 554 tests passed.
- `pnpm typecheck` passed.
- `pnpm build` passed for all packages.
- `pnpm build:electron-demo` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.

I also manually checked the main user flows in the Electron demo:

1. Open the search panel from the toolbar.
2. Enable Fuzzy and search normal text and rendered Markdown links.
3. Use previous/next and confirm that results move from top to bottom in document order.
4. Confirm that the current result uses the darker yellow highlight while the other results remain light yellow.
5. Close the panel and confirm that fuzzy decorations, temporary link markers, and tooltip nodes are removed.

A short demo recording is available for the updated search interaction and UI fixes.

## Review notes

I intentionally did not expand this change into the editor Core. A future edge case is two completely identical links on the same source line; solving that precisely would require a stable source range from Core and would be larger than this MVP.

Please let me know if you would prefer any part of the UI polish to be split into a separate follow-up PR.

title: fix(slash): handle menu clicks inside shadow DOM
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Fix slash menu item interactions when `createSlashMenuUI` is mounted inside a `ShadowRoot`.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

The document-level outside-click handler used `event.target` together with `root.contains(target)`.

When a composed event crosses a Shadow DOM boundary, `event.target` is retargeted to the shadow host for listeners outside the shadow tree. As a result, clicking a slash menu item could be incorrectly treated as an outside click, dismissing the menu before the command was confirmed.

This change uses the event's composed propagation path so menu-internal interactions are detected correctly in both light DOM and Shadow DOM.

- Issue: N/A
- Roadmap (`docs/ROADMAP.md`): N/A
- OpenSpec change: N/A — this is a focused bug fix with no new capability or public API change.

  - Replace the `event.target` containment check with `event.composedPath()`.
  - Preserve the existing outside-click dismissal behavior for regular DOM usage.
  - Add a Shadow DOM regression test that mounts the menu inside a real `ShadowRoot`.
  - Verify that `mousedown` does not dismiss the menu before the item `click` handler confirms the command.
- `packages/core`: No changes.

title: fix(electron): keep wiki-link backlinks consistent after file changes

## Summary / 摘要

Keep wiki-link backlinks consistent when files are added to or removed from the Electron demo vault.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

LinkIndex.updateFile() only rebuilt reverse edges originating from the changed file, while removeFile() only removed edges whose source was deleted. That is correct for content-only edits, but file additions and removals change the target candidate set globally.

This could leave stale backlinks after deleting a target, fail to resolve existing links after adding a target, and retain incorrect results when basename ambiguity changed.

- Issue: N/A
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): existing wikilinks / note-vault behavior
- OpenSpec change: not required (bug fix)

- Preserve incremental reverse-index updates for edits to existing files.
- Rebuild reverse edges after file additions or removals that change link-resolution topology.
- Add regression coverage for:
  - deleting a linked target;
  - adding a previously missing target;
  - removing one of two ambiguous basename targets;

title: fix(live-preview): use live doc content for table column/row operations
body:
fix(live-preview): use live doc content for table column/row operations

## Summary / 摘要

When adding or deleting columns/rows in a table, the operation now reads
cell content from the live editor document instead of the stale widget
snapshot. This fixes the 'click-twice' bug where the first add/delete
would fail because it used outdated content.

对表格进行添加或删除行列操作时，现在从实时编辑器文档读取单元格内容，
而不是过时的 widget 快照。这修复了"点击两次"的 bug——第一次操作会失败，
因为使用的是过期内容。

## Motivation / 背景与动机

When a user clicks to add a column or delete a row in a table cell that
has pending uncommitted edits (IME input, selection, etc.), the widget
snapshot used for computing new cell content was stale. Two scenarios:

1. **Add column**: snapshot shows old column count → new column gets wrong content
2. **Delete row**: snapshot shows old row count → operation fails or deletes wrong row

用户点击添加列或删除行时，如果单元格有未提交的编辑（输入法输入、选区等），
widget 快照用于计算新单元格内容时已经过期。两种场景：

1. **添加列**：快照显示旧的列数 → 新列内容错误
2. **删除行**：快照显示旧的行数 → 操作失败或删错行

- Issue: 点击两次才能成功添加/删除行列
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): live-preview stability / cell interaction
- OpenSpec change: n/a (bug fix, no new capability)

## Changes / 变更内容

**Rebased to single commit** — previous 8 commits reverted and rebuilt as one clean commit.

- `packages/core`:
  - `live-preview-table.ts`: range detection rewritten to walk `doc.lineAt()` boundaries
    instead of guessing via `this.source.length + 512`. Prevents eating trailing
    paragraphs and missing rows on long tables.
  - `live-preview-table.ts`: stale guard restored in `dispatch()` and `addRow()` — checks
    that the live slice still looks like a table start before writing back.
  - `live-preview-table.ts`: all structural ops (`addColumn`, `deleteColumn`, `addRow`,
    `deleteRow`, `moveColumn`, `moveRow`) now read from `liveSource()` so cell edits
    made between re-renders are reflected in the next operation.
  - `packages/core/test/live-preview-table-ops.test.ts`: new regression suite covering
    trailing body preservation, live cell content after focus lock, IME composition,
    and undo/redo round-trip.
- `packages/plugin-*`: no changes
- `apps/electron-demo`: no changes

  `packages/core/test/live-preview-table-ops.test.ts` — 5 regression scenarios:

  2. Trailing paragraphs preserved after addRow
  3. First-click after cell edit reads live content (not stale snapshot)
  4. IME composition text survives the next addColumn
  5. Undo/redo round-trip for addColumn

  - Add column after IME input → new column gets correct content ✓

title: fix(core): preserve async asset insertion anchors
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Preserve paste and drop insertion anchors while asset uploads are pending, then insert each successful batch in one document transaction.

在资源异步上传期间保持粘贴和拖放的原始插入位置，并将同批成功结果通过一次文档事务原子插入。

## Motivation / 背景与动机

The default asset fallback previously called `replaceSelection()` after every upload resolved. That used the selection at completion time rather than the position where the paste or drop started: moving the cursor redirected the Markdown, editing the original selection could overwrite newer content, and multi-file uploads created multiple undo steps.

- Issue: none
- Roadmap: N/A — bug fix
- OpenSpec change: N/A — internal bug fix with no public API or new capability

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/core`:
  - Track every initiating selection range in a CodeMirror `StateField` and map it through document transactions.
  - Preserve selection-boundary and multi-cursor semantics; derive drop anchors from pointer coordinates.
  - Upload files serially, isolate individual failures, and commit successful results in one undoable transaction.
  - Discard stale results after `setDocument()` or editor destruction, and skip the default pipeline in read-only editors.
- Other packages / `apps/electron-demo` / `openspec`: N/A

title: feat(search): add fuzzy search support
body:
## Why

`@floatboat/nexus-plugin-search` 当前只支持精确子串、whole-word 和正则匹配。对于「想用缩写快速定位」的典型场景——比如输入 `hw` 找到 `hello world`——用户必须输入完整词或切换到正则。

模糊搜索在 Obsidian、VS Code、Sublime 等现代编辑器中已是标准能力，缺它会让 plugin-search 的可用性落后一档。

Roadmap #17 标记为 P2 planned，本次实现填补这个缺口。

## What

新增 `SearchOptions.fuzzy?: boolean` 选项，开启后 `findSearchMatches` / `replaceAllMatches` 走模糊匹配路径；关闭时行为完全不变。

### 算法

按行 DP，复杂度 O(nLen × L²)，对编辑器中典型短行（< 200 字符）足够快。

评分维度（基线 + 增量）：

| 维度 | 分值 |
|---|---|
| 每个匹配字符 | +10 |
| 连续匹配 | +5/字符 |
| 词首匹配 | +8/字符 |
| camelCase 边界（小写→大写） | +4/字符 |
| 短跳跃（≤ 3 字符） | +3/字符 |
| 长跳跃 | −2/字符 |
| 任意非连续跳跃 | −1 |

### API 变更

```typescript
// 之前
findSearchMatches("hello world", "hw"); // → []

// 之后
findSearchMatches("hello world", "hw", { fuzzy: true });
// → [{ from: 0, to: 7, text: "hello w" }]

// 替换同样支持
replaceAllMatches("hello world", "hw", "FOO", { fuzzy: true });
// → "FOOorld"
```

新增的可选 `minScoreRatio` 允许调用方按理论最高分的比例过滤低质量匹配。

### 公开导出

`packages/plugin-search/src/index.ts` 顶层导出无新增；`SearchOptions` 扩展 `FuzzyMatchOptions`（`caseSensitive`, `minScoreRatio`）。

`packages/plugin-search/src/fuzzy.ts` 新增文件，但**不**作为公开导出（属于实现细节，外部通过 `SearchOptions.fuzzy` 间接使用）。

## Files changed

```
A  packages/plugin-search/README.md            (+203)
A  packages/plugin-search/src/fuzzy.ts         (+255)
A  packages/plugin-search/test/fuzzy.test.ts   (+170)

```

总计：3 个新文件、4 个修改文件、约 705 行新增。

## Testing

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `pnpm test` | ✅ 567/567 通过（新增 30 个 fuzzy 测试） |
| `pnpm typecheck` | ✅ 通过 |
| `pnpm build` | ✅ 11 个包全部成功 |

新增测试覆盖：

- `fuzzy.test.ts`（20 个）：空串、精确匹配、跳跃匹配、词首匹配、camelCase、阈值过滤、大小写、多行、CJK、替换
- `plugin-search.test.ts`（10 个新增）：集成到 `findSearchMatches` / `replaceAllMatches` 的 `fuzzy` 选项、向后兼容、阈值转发

## Backward compatibility

`fuzzy` 默认 `false`，所有现有调用点行为不变。无破坏性变更。

## Performance

对 1000 行、每行平均 80 字符的文档、单字符 query，per-line DP 跑 1000 次约 10ms（Node 22）。对长行（> 500 字符）会变慢；生产环境建议配合 `minScoreRatio` 提前过滤或加防抖。性能基准将在后续单独提案中提供（`add-missing-features` 4.2 已规划）。

## Manual verification

本 PR 不改 UI（`createSearchPlugin` 未触及，search panel 行为不变），按 CONTRIBUTING §4 不需要在 electron-demo 手动跑。验证方式：

1. **单元测试**：30 个新测试覆盖 fuzzy 算法、集成点、向后兼容、边界
2. **端到端冒烟**（在构建产物上跑）：

```bash
$ node -e "
const { findSearchMatches, replaceAllMatches } = require('./packages/plugin-search/dist/index.js');
console.log(findSearchMatches('hello world', 'hw', { fuzzy: true }));
console.log(replaceAllMatches('hello world', 'hw', 'FOO', { fuzzy: true }));
"
# → [ { from: 0, to: 7, text: 'hello w' } ]
# → FOOorld
```

如果 maintainer 想要在 search panel UI 里加 fuzzy 开关（这是合理的 follow-up），需要单独 PR + UI 改动走 `add-missing-features` 之外的提案流程。

## Notes

- 不引入新运行时依赖
- 不触及 `core`，符合最小变更原则
- 不影响 search panel UI 行为（`createSearchPlugin` 未变）；panel 集成 fuzzy 留待后续提案
- 未提交 OpenSpec 提案（Roadmap 明确标注 #17 不需要 OpenSpec）

title: fix(live-preview): make image rendering AST-driven and linked images navigable
body: ## Summary / 摘要 Image ranges in the live preview now come from the AST instead of a document-wide regex scan, which fixes garbled/blank rendering of linked images (`[![alt](img)](url)`, the README-badge pattern), images being injected into code blocks, and truncated parenthesized URLs — and linked images are now clickable with the destination shown on hover. ## Motivation / 背景与动机 - Issue: none filed — found while exercising the live preview against common README patterns. - Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): n/a (bug fix) - OpenSpec change: n/a (bug fix, per CONTRIBUTING §3.1) The live preview located images with a regex over the whole document (`collectImageRanges`), blind to parse context. Three user-visible bugs shared that root cause: 1. **Linked images render garbage.** For `[![CI badge](…)](https://example.com)` the link's marker arithmetic splits at the *first* `](` — inside the nested image — so the label rendered as `![CI badge` with a fragment URL; the overlapping image/link decorations could also trip CM6 and degrade the whole view to raw markdown. This is the standard CI-badge pattern at the top of virtually every README. 2. **Code contexts are not literal.** ` ```…``` ` and inline code containing `![alt](url)` grew real image widgets — you couldn't write documentation *about* image syntax, and pasted code got corrupted visually. 3. **CommonMark URL edge cases.** `![Wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foo_(bar))` was truncated at the first `)`, leaving a broken image and a stray paren. Only the parser knows whether `![…](…)` sits in prose or inside a code span, and only the parser resolves balanced parens — so the fix is to emit image ranges from the AST walk like every other inline node and delete the regex scan. ## Changes / 变更内容 - `packages/core`: - `live-preview-ranges.ts`: delete `collectImageRanges`; add `image` to the AST-walk node set; skip reference-style images (no inline URL) so they stay raw text. - `live-preview.ts`: new linked-image branch — links whose label contains an image (at any depth, incl. inside emphasis/strong/delete) render as a single clickable widget (`data-link-url` + destination tooltip, including on inner ``s, where it outranks renderer-set alt tooltips). Cursor-aware like standalone images: cursor out → replace widget; cursor in → editable source + block preview below (so a freshly pasted badge shows immediately). The widget must **not** swallow events (CM6 skips all `domEventHandlers` for `ignoreEvent() === true` widgets, which would kill the navigation handler). Link navigation now filters schemes: only `http(s)`/`mailto:` reach `window.open`; scheme-less GFM autolinks (`www.…`) get an `https://` prefix instead of navigating relatively. - `lezer-mdast-adapter.ts`: images keep their CommonMark title (`![a](url "title")` — previously dropped, used by tooltip-rendering hosts); a `Link` node with no inline URL (reference-style `[x][ref]`, empty `[x]()`) now yields `url: ""` instead of leaking the whole raw source as its URL (autolinks keep the node-text fallback). - `apps/electron-demo`: - `electron/main.ts` + new `electron/link-policy.ts`: the demo never installed a window-open handler, so link clicks spawned bare child BrowserWindows. `http(s)`/`mailto:` now route to the system browser via `shell.openExternal`; everything else is denied, and `will-navigate` is guarded the same way (same-page reloads stay allowed). The policy is a pure, unit-tested module. **Behavior notes** - `![](url)` (empty alt) no longer shows the URL as a text label next to the image — the adapter emits `alt: ""` (spec-consistent with remark) where the old regex emitted `null` and the default renderer fell back to the URL. - `mailto:` links in the demo used to open a broken child window; they now open the system mail handler. - Commit `ce3e5d2` bundles the navigation fix with the hover-tooltip change; they land together because both exist to make the linked-image widget behave like a link. ## Testing / 测试 - [x] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿 — 533 tests across 34 files - [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) / 受影响包构建通过（含 `pnpm typecheck`） - [x] New / updated vitest cases / 新增或更新的 vitest 用例：**18 new cases** - `live-preview-ranges.test.ts`: no image ranges in fenced/inline code or raw HTML blocks; balanced-paren URLs; all three CommonMark title delimiter forms (+ no-title → `null`); linked-image emits link + suppressed child ranges; reference-style images/links stay raw / get `url: ""`. - `live-preview-regressions.test.ts`: linked image renders as clickable widget (attrs, tooltip on wrapper **and** ``); cursor-in shows raw source + exactly **one** preview (parentSpans suppression); a dispatched `mousedown` calls `window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener")` — this is the only way to catch a regression to an event-swallowing widget, since the DOM is identical either way; scheme filtering (`javascript:` consumed, `www.…` prefixed); labels with images nested in emphasis; mixed text-and-multiple-images labels; reference-style linked image renders without a fake destination. - `apps/electron-demo/test/link-policy.test.ts`: external-target allowlist and same-page-reload rules. - [x] Manual UI check in electron-demo / electron-demo 手动验证： - CI badge line: renders as clickable image; hover shows destination; click opens the **system browser**; cursor on the line shows editable source with live preview below; cursor away collapses to the widget. - ` ``` ` blocks and inline code show `![…](…)` as literal text; `**bold**` and images now behave consistently in code contexts. - Parenthesized Wikipedia-style URLs load in full; multi-badge paragraphs, badges inside headings/lists/blockquotes, and mid-edit broken syntax (deleting the closing paren, then restoring) never blank the preview. ## Compliance / 合规自检 - [ ] **CLA signed** — will sign when the bot prompts - [x] **AI disclosure**: AI assistance is described below. AI-assisted notes / AI 使用说明： AI assistance (Claude Code) was used for implementation and test drafting under my direction: I selected the bugs, reproduced them, drove the design decisions (AST-driven ranges over regex, matching the standalone-image cursor contract, event-swallowing tradeoffs), verified every scenario manually in the demo, and reviewed the final diff line by line. I can walk through and defend any part of the change. - [x] **New dependencies**: none - [x] **No build artifacts** committed - [x] **No secrets** committed ## Checklist / 自检清单 - [x] Title follows Conventional Commits - [ ] Public API changes update package README / types — n/a: no public API surface changed (adapter output enrichment only) - [x] Touched `live-preview-table.ts` → n/a, not touched - [x] New capability / breaking change → n/a, bug fixes only - [x] Change aligns with project scope (GOVERNANCE.md §4) ## Screenshots / Recordings · 截图或录屏 (UI changes) Same document, electron-demo. Test document: ~~~markdown # Image rendering [![CI badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-passing-green)](https://example.com) ``` ![alt](https://example.com/img.png) ``` Inline `![x](https://example.com/y.png)` code ![parens](https://img.shields.io/badge/paren_(url)-works-blue) ~~~ **Before (main):** the linked image renders as the garbled label `![CI badge`; image widgets are injected inside the fenced block and inline code; the parenthesized URL is truncated (`404 badge not found` + stray `-works-blue)` text). ![before: garbled linked image, images inside code blocks, truncated URL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rotiokivv/Nexus-Editor/pr-assets/1-before-broken.png) **After (this branch):** the badge renders as a clickable image (hover shows the destination, click opens the system browser); code contexts stay literal; the parenthesized URL loads in full. ![after: badge renders, code stays literal, full URL loads](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rotiokivv/Nexus-Editor/pr-assets/2-after-fixed.png) **After, cursor on the badge line:** the raw source stays editable with the live preview rendered right below — same contract as standalone images. ![after: cursor on the badge line shows editable source with preview below](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rotiokivv/Nexus-Editor/pr-assets/3-after-edit-mode.png)

body:
## Summary
- Add backtracking DP fuzzy search to `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-search` with score-ranked overlap deduplication.

Nexus roadmap P2 called for a fuzzy matcher with backtracking rather than literal-only search. This keeps Markdown as the source of truth while letting power users jump to subsequence matches (e.g. `fc` → `func`) inside the existing CodeMirror search UI.

title: feat(core): add offset-based sync-scroll preview primitives
body: ## Summary / 摘要 Offset-based (not percentage) two-way scroll sync between the editor and a new read-only rendered preview pane: three small core primitives (`scroll` event, `scrollToOffset`, `renderPreviewHtml`) plus a reference implementation in the electron demo behind an opt-in toggle (default off). ## Motivation / 背景与动机 - Issue: — - Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): #13 — Markdown live preview sync scroll (P2); status planned → in-progress per the roadmap maintenance rules - OpenSpec change: `openspec/changes/add-sync-scroll-preview` (proposal / design / 2 spec deltas / tasks, included in this PR) This re-attempts roadmap #13 with the concerns that closed PR #118 designed out from the start: 1. **Single concern** — scroll sync only. No keybinding UI. Wiki-link rendering in the preview is an explicit non-goal: it surfaced a pre-existing `lezer-mdast-adapter.ts` quirk, documented in design.md as a standalone follow-up instead of bundled here. (Two *other* narrow adapter fixes — table `align` and task-item text — are included because the preview functionally depends on them; the scope judgment distinguishing the two cases is in design.md.) 2. **Offset-anchored, not percentage** — the editor emits the document offset at the top of the viewport (`lineBlockAtHeight`, CM6 content-space); the preview aligns the nearest `data-offset` block top. Sub-block ratio interpolation was deliberately dropped after self-review found the two sides measure "ratio" in incompatible units (source line vs. AST block) — design.md has the full analysis. 3. **Opt-in** — default off; zero default-behavior change. ## Changes / 变更内容 - `packages/core`: - New rAF-throttled `scroll` event `{ offset, ratio }` — ViewPlugin on `scrollDOM`, content-space `lineBlockAtHeight`, no screen-coordinate math; the CM6 `EditorView` is still never exposed to hosts - New `EditorAPI.scrollToOffset(offset, ratio?)` — write-side counterpart, same line-based unit - New `renderPreviewHtml(ast)` — mdast → HTML via the already-present `remark-rehype` + `rehype-stringify` (transform-only, no re-parse), top-level blocks tagged with `data-offset`; exported `ScrollPayload`; README updated - ⚠️ Two narrow fixes to the shared `lezer-mdast-adapter.ts`, called out explicitly: `adaptTable` hardcoded `align: []` (and `mdast-util-to-hast` emits exactly `align.length` cells per row, so preview tables rendered as cell-less `` shells) and the Task branch looked for child nodes where Lezer keeps item text implicit in gaps (task items rendered as bare checkboxes). Fixed at the source rather than papered over in the preview — the task text is unrecoverable downstream, and other `getAst()` consumers (e.g. plugin-wordcount silently skipping task-item text) were affected too. Full scope judgment vs. the deliberately-deferred wiki-link adapter bug is in design.md; `exportHTML()` is unaffected (it re-parses via remark-parse). Happy to split these into their own PR if preferred. - `apps/electron-demo`: - New `preview-panel.ts`: read-only rendered pane, bidirectional block-top sync, two-frame echo guard - Link-click interception: plain click swallowed (`electron/main.ts` has no `will-navigate` guard, so an unhandled click would navigate the whole BrowserWindow away); Ctrl/Cmd-click opens externally — same convention as the inline live-preview link renderer; non-absolute hrefs are a no-op - Toolbar toggle + `splitPreview` setting (default **off**) - ⚠️ One shared-helper fix, called out explicitly: `togglePanel()` restored panels with `style.display = ""`, which drops the inline `display:flex` these panels rely on. It now takes an explicit show-display value — this also fixes the same latent bug for the outline/vault/backlinks panels. Rationale in design.md; happy to split this out if you prefer. - `openspec/`: `add-sync-scroll-preview` — proposal, design (decisions + self-review findings), spec deltas for `editor-core` and `sync-scroll-preview`, tasks - New runtime dependencies: **none** ## Testing / 测试 - [x] `pnpm test` passes — 535 tests, 20 new across `scroll-event.test.ts`, `live-preview-to-html.test.ts` (incl. 3 adapter regression tests: table cells + alignment, task text + checkbox + inline formatting, nested blocks under a task), `preview-panel.test.ts` - [x] Affected packages build — `pnpm build`, `pnpm build:electron-demo`, `pnpm typecheck` all clean - [x] Manual UI check in electron-demo across three rounds: toggled split preview on/off; verified top→bottom scroll alignment in both directions across headings, paragraphs, code fences, and tables; no feedback-loop jitter; panel stays off on a fresh profile. These passes surfaced and drove the fixes for three real-browser-only layout bugs, the window.open relative-href issue, and the empty-table / textless-task adapter bugs (tasks.md 4.4, 6.9, 6.10). ## Compliance / 合规自检 - [x] **CLA signed** - [x] **AI disclosure**: AI辅助笔记： 工具：claude code（主要编码助手）；AI辅助也用于英文文档编写和代码审查。 AI的使用方式： 1. 代码库理解——在设计工作之前，探索现有的实时预览/ lezer-mdast-adapter/演示面板架构。 2. 代码草拟——我设定了设计 AI根据该设计草拟了代码； 我审查并根据情况修改了代码。 3. 测试草拟——AI帮助编写了我指定行为的测试用例 4. 英文写作——我的工作语言是中文； AI 帮助我规范化了我的设计笔记和想法，并将其整理成英文 README 部分、OpenSpec 提案/设计/规范/任务以及代码注释，此外还处理了一些繁琐和机械性工作 5. 搜索查询，整理资料 由我完成：上述设计决策及其权衡（记录在 design.md 中）；所有功能代码的代码审查；所有手动验证 我可以解释并捍卫此 PR 中的每个设计决策。 （节流、销毁清理、数据偏移完整性、链接点击安全性包括 wiki 链接垃圾 href 的情况） - [x] **New dependencies**: none - [x] **No build artifacts** committed - [x] **No secrets** committed ## Checklist / 自检清单 - [x] Title follows Conventional Commits - [x] Public API changes update package README / types - [x] `live-preview-table.ts` not touched (n/a) - [x] New capability → OpenSpec change linked (`add-sync-scroll-preview`) - [x] Change aligns with project scope (GOVERNANCE.md §4) ## Screenshots / Recordings

title: refactor(core): standardize Widget API with EditorWidget base class
body:
## Summary

Unify the two separate widget systems under a shared `EditorWidget` base class. Replace the bare `tableEditingCount` global with `isWidgetEditing()`. Add lifecycle hooks and `WidgetContext`.

## Motivation

- **Roadmap**: P1 "Widget API 标准化" (`docs/ROADMAP.md` #9)
- **OpenSpec**: `openspec/changes/add-widget-api-standardization/`

Before this PR, Nexus had two independent widget systems with zero shared infrastructure. The bare `tableEditingCount` global was untestable. Plugin widgets had no lifecycle hooks or lock management.

## Changes

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `packages/core/src/widget-base.ts` | **New** — `EditorWidget` abstract base class |
| `packages/core/src/widget-state.ts` | **New** — `isWidgetEditing()` / lock management |
| `packages/core/src/widget-context.ts` | **New** — `WidgetContext` interface |
| `packages/core/src/live-preview-table.ts` | `EditableTableWidget extends EditorWidget` |
| `packages/core/src/widget-extension.ts` | `NexusWidget extends EditorWidget` + lifecycle |
| `packages/core/src/types.ts` | Added `WidgetLifecycleHooks`, deprecated `destroy` |
| `packages/core/test/live-preview.test.ts` | 6 new table clipboard/selection tests |

### Architecture
```
Before: WidgetType (bare CM6)       After: EditorWidget (locks + lifecycle)
        ├─ EditableTableWidget             ├─ EditableTableWidget
        └─ NexusWidget                     └─ NexusWidget
        tableEditingCount (global)         isWidgetEditing()
```

## Testing

- [x] `pnpm test` — **521 tests, 34 files, 0 failures**
- [x] TypeScript — zero errors
- [x] OpenSpec proposal at `openspec/changes/add-widget-api-standardization/`

title: fix^(live-preview^)^: place caret at click point inside table cells
body: # PR: fix(live-preview): place caret at click point inside table cells PR title (Conventional Commits): fix(live-preview): place caret at click point inside table cells Scope `live-preview` = `packages/core/src/live-preview-table.ts`. ## Summary / 摘要 Clicking inside a table cell now lands the caret at the clicked character boundary instead of snapping to the cell origin or to the styled wrapper's mapped start offset (e.g. `重点菜单`). 点击表格单元格任意位置,光标会落在被点击的字符边界,而不是被强制 吸到单元格起点或样式包裹元素(如 ``)的内嵌文本起点。 ## Motivation / 背景与动机 A user clicking in the middle of a Chinese cell rendered with inline markup (`**重点菜单**`, `[*重点菜单*](url)`, `` `Ctrl+Z` ``) saw the caret jump to either the very start of the cell or to the start offset of the inner wrapped Text node — never to the actual character boundary they clicked on. Three independent paths contributed to the wrong caret position: - `rawSourceOffsetFromPoint` collapsed every left-half click on a styled cell to the mapped start of the inner Text (e.g. raw offset 2 for ``**重点菜单**``) because sub-rect fallback only handled non-Text offsetNodes, and the sub-rect path was applied unconditionally. - `placeRawSourceCaret` bailed out as soon as `td.firstChild` was an Element instead of a Text — every styled cell silently dropped the caret. - The Enter-into-edit-mode closure ran twice (once from the click handler, once from the focus listener) and the second call's `td.textContent = src` tore down the range that the first call had just placed. - Issue: addresses the user-reported "点 cell 中间光标跳到最前" symptom - Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): live-preview stability / cell interaction - OpenSpec change: n/a (bug fix, no new capability) ## Changes / 变更内容 - `packages/core`: - `rawSourceOffsetFromPoint`: gate sub-rect hit-testing behind `apiTextHit` — when the browser API already returns a Text node we trust caretPos directly (more accurate for CJK / monospace), and only fall back to sub-rect when the API returns a wrapper Element (``, ``, ``, ``, ``). - `rawSourceOffsetFromCaret`: walk up the parent chain to find the nearest registered source range, instead of only looking at the container's own child slots. The first-iteration hit is unchanged for the common Text case; the fallback covers the rare wrapper case. - `placeRawSourceCaret`: use a TreeWalker to find the first descendant Text instead of `td.firstChild`, so styled cells get a concrete anchor and the caret lands at the requested raw offset. - `EditableTableWidget.enterEditMode` closure: idempotent guard — if the cell already holds the raw source as a single Text node we skip the destructive `textContent` swap that was destroying the just- placed range. - `packages/plugin-*`: no changes - `apps/electron-demo`: no changes (manual testing was done in a separate scratch branch, not included in this PR) - `openspec/`: no changes ## Testing / 测试 - [x] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿 `vitest run packages/core/test/live-preview.test.ts` → 70/70 - [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) / 受影响包构建通过 `tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json` → 0 errors - [x] New / updated vitest cases / 新增或更新的 vitest 用例 The existing suite already covers the click → caret path indirectly; the fix is observable in the demo (see "Manual UI check" below). Adding two pinpoint unit assertions for `placeRawSourceCaret` with a styled cell is tracked separately as a follow-up; intentionally out of scope for this minimal-change PR. - [x] Manual UI check in electron-demo / electron-demo 手动验证: - Click middle of plain text cell → caret at clicked character ✓ - Click inside `**重点菜单**` → caret at clicked character ✓ - Click inside `[重点菜单](url)` → caret at clicked character ✓ - Click inside `` `Ctrl+Z` `` → caret at clicked character ✓ - IME / drag-select / search highlight (covered by prior PRs) unchanged. ## Compliance / 合规自检 - [x] **CLA signed** — bot will prompt if needed - [x] **AI disclosure**: the functional code in this PR is **not** primarily generated by AI. AI assistance was used to draft the ancestor-walk refactor of `rawSourceOffsetFromCaret` and to draft the comment block explaining why sub-rect hit-testing is gated behind `apiTextHit`. The bug reproductions and the manual verification were done by the human contributor. AI-assisted notes / AI 使用说明: - ancestor walk in `rawSourceOffsetFromCaret` — AI-drafted refactor of the original children-walk fallback - `[Fix-A]` comment in `rawSourceOffsetFromPoint` — AI-drafted explanation of why we trust the API over sub-rect for Text nodes - [x] **New dependencies** (if any) listed with license & rationale: none - [x] **No build artifacts** committed - [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed ## Checklist / 自检清单 - [x] Title follows Conventional Commits / 标题遵循 Conventional Commits - [x] Public API changes update package README / types — no public API changed; all four edits are inside `live-preview-table.ts` and keep the existing widget behaviour observable from outside - [ ] Touched `live-preview-table.ts` → walked through the 12 Table Widget rules in CLAUDE.md: 1. source round-trip — unchanged, no edits to markdown parsing 2-7. (cell focus / editing / IME / selection) — IME path unaffected; selection path was re-confirmed via the manual checklist above 8. read-only mode toggle — unaffected 9. multi-cell selection across the table — unaffected (only single-cell click path changed) 10. undo/redo — unaffected 11. copy/paste — unaffected 12. fixture parity with prosemirror-tables — unaffected - [x] New capability / breaking change → OpenSpec proposal linked: n/a (bug fix, no new capability) - [x] Change aligns with project scope (GOVERNANCE.md §4): yes — table widget caret placement is core scope ## Screenshots / Recordings · 截图或录屏 (UI changes) Before: clicking mid-cell snaps caret to cell origin or styled-wrapper start. After: caret lands at the clicked character boundary in plain text, `strong`, `em`, `link`, and inline-code cells alike. Manual probe data captured during development: rawOffset === caretPos.offset for every probe ownInMap === true (click-time Text is the same Text we register) ancestor chain stable across renders (See scratch branch `fix/table-search-highlight` which carried the diagnostics harness; not part of this PR.)

title: feat(plugin-search): add optional fuzzy matching to findSearchMatches
body:
## What

Adds an opt-in `fuzzy` option to `findSearchMatches` in `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-search`.
Implements roadmap item #17 (Fuzzy search, P2).

When `{ fuzzy: true }` is passed, each line is matched as a subsequence of
the query and annotated with a relevance `score`, so callers can rank results.

## Why

Exact and regex search require the query to appear contiguously. Fuzzy
matching lets users find lines by typing a loose, ordered subset of the
characters — the same interaction model as a command palette / file finder.

## Design

- **Per-line matching.** Each line is treated as a candidate, so a match's
  `from`/`to` stays bounded to a single line instead of spanning the whole
  document.
- **Greedy left-most subsequence** with a small scoring function
  (contiguous runs, word-start hits, and a leading match are rewarded; gaps
  are penalized). Scoring style mirrors the existing `slash-state.ts` ranking.
- Query characters are always literal (never regex) in fuzzy mode.
- Results stay in document order; sorting by `score` is left to the caller.

## Scope / non-goals

- Purely additive and opt-in — default, regex, whole-word, and case-sensitive
  behavior are unchanged.
- `replaceAllMatches`, the CM6 search panel, and search history are untouched.
- No new dependencies.

## Tests

Added 8 unit tests (fuzzy vs exact, out-of-order rejection, document order,
case sensitivity, literal-not-regex, empty query, score ranking, and "no
score on exact matches"). Full suite: 37/37 passing; package typecheck clean.
